summary.text: Patricia Muga is the Republican candidate for California State Assembly District 20 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Liz Ortega (D).

paragraphs.text: Patricia Muga also ran for an at-large seat on the Alameda County Flood Control Board of Directors and lost in the election held June 2, 2026.

According to Ballotpedia's summary of the campaign website, Muga supports the California Voter ID Initiative, a full audit of Secretary of State voter data, support for local sheriffs and police, and accountability for the allocation of public funds, including to non-governmental organizations.
